shloka_text: तथोक्तवति रामे तु तस्य जन्म तदद्भुतम् । उवाच लक्ष्मणो भूयो भरतश्च महायशाः ।। 7.90.1 ।।
transliteration: tathoktavati rāme tu tasya janma tadadbhutam | uvāca lakṣmaṇo bhūyo bharataśca mahāyaśāḥ || 7.90.1 ||
translation: तथा thus, उक्तवति having spoken, रामे Rama, तु but, तस्य his (Pururavas's), जन्म birth, तत् that, अद्भुतम् wonderful, उवाच spoke, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भूयः again, भरतः Bharata, च and, महायशाः highly renowned.
explanation: When Rama had thus spoken about that wonderful birth of Pururavas, Lakshmana and the highly renowned Bharata spoke again.
comments: Asked what became of Ila, Rama tells how Budha gathered the sages, Kardama among them, who for Ila's sake perform an Ashvamedha to Rudra -- pleased, Shiva restores Ila to permanent manhood; Ila founds Pratishthana and rules, Shashabindu takes Bahli, and Pururavas succeeds him -- such, says Rama, is the power of the horse-sacrifice.

shloka_text: इला सा सोमपुत्रस्य संवत्सरमथोषिता । अकरोत्किं नरश्रेष्ठ तत्त्वं शंसितुमर्हसि ।। 7.90.2 ।।
transliteration: ilā sā somaputrasya saṃvatsaramathoṣitā | akarotkiṃ naraśreṣṭha tattvaṃ śaṃsitumarhasi || 7.90.2 ||
translation: इला Ila, सा she, सोमपुत्रस्य of the son of Soma (Budha), संवत्सरम् for a year, अथ then, उषिता having resided, अकरोत् did, किं what, नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, तत्त्वं the truth, शंसितुम् to tell, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: O best of men, you ought to tell us the truth about what Ila did after she resided with Budha, the son of Soma, for a year.

shloka_text: तयोस्तद्वाक्यमाधुर्यं निशम्य परिपृच्छतोः । रामः पुनरुवाचेमां प्रजापतिसुते कथाम् ।। 7.90.3 ।।
transliteration: tayostadvākyamādhuryaṃ niśamya paripṛcchatoḥ | rāmaḥ punaruvācemāṃ prajāpatisute kathām || 7.90.3 ||
translation: tayoḥ of those two, tat that, vākyamādhuryam sweetness of speech, niśamya having heard, paripṛcchatoḥ who were asking, rāmaḥ Rama, punar again, uvāca said, imām this, prajāpatisute O daughter of Prajapati, kathām story.
explanation: Having heard the sweet words of those two who were questioning, Rama again told this story, O daughter of Prajapati.

shloka_text: पुरुषत्वं गते शूरे बुधः परमबुद्धिमान् । संवर्तं परमोदारमाजुहाव महायशाः ।। 7.90.4 ।।
transliteration: puruṣatvaṃ gate śūre budhaḥ paramabuddhimān | saṃvartaṃ paramodāramājuhāva mahāyaśāḥ || 7.90.4 ||
translation: puruṣatvam manhood, gate having attained, śūre the brave one, budhaḥ Budha, paramabuddhimān extremely intelligent, saṃvartam Samvarta, paramodāram extremely generous, ājuhāva invited, mahāyaśāḥ highly renowned.
explanation: When the brave one (Ila/Sudyumna) attained manhood, the highly renowned and extremely intelligent Budha invited the exceedingly generous sage Samvarta.

shloka_text: च्यवनं भृगुपुत्रं च मुनिं चारिष्टनेमिनम् । प्रमोदनं मोदकरं ततो दुर्वाससं मुनिम् ।। 7.90.5 ।।
transliteration: cyavanaṃ bhṛguputraṃ ca muniṃ cāriṣṭaneminam | pramodanaṃ modakaraṃ tato durvāsasaṃ munim || 7.90.5 ||
translation: cyavanam Chyavana, bhṛguputram son of Bhrigu, ca and, munim sage, ca and, ariṣṭaneminam Arishtanemi, pramodanam Pramodana, modakaram who causes joy, tataḥ then, durvāsasam Durvasas, munim sage.
explanation: He also invited Chyavana, the son of Bhrigu, the sage Arishtanemi, Pramodana who brings joy, and then the sage Durvasas.

shloka_text: एतान्सर्वान्समानीय वाक्यज्ञस्तत्त्वदर्शनः । उवाच सर्वान्सुहृदो धैर्येण सुसमाहितान् ।। 7.90.6 ।।
transliteration: etānsarvānsamānīya vākyajñastattvadarśanaḥ | uvāca sarvānsuhṛdo dhairyeṇa susamāhitān || 7.90.6 ||
translation: etān these, sarvān all, samānīya having gathered, vākyajñaḥ one who knows speech, tattvadarśanaḥ one who sees the truth, uvāca said, sarvān to all, suhṛdaḥ friends, dhairyeṇa with patience, susamāhitān well-composed.
explanation: Having gathered all these, the eloquent and perceptive Budha spoke to all his well-composed friends with patience.

shloka_text: अयं राजा महाबाहुः कर्दमस्य इलः सुतः । जानीतैनं यथाभूतं श्रेयो ह्यत्र विधीयताम् ।। 7.90.7 ।।
transliteration: ayaṃ rājā mahābāhuḥ kardamasya ilaḥ sutaḥ | jānītainaṃ yathābhūtaṃ śreyo hyatra vidhīyatām || 7.90.7 ||
translation: ayam this, rājā king, mahābāhuḥ mighty-armed, kardamasya of Kardama, ilaḥ Ila, sutaḥ son, jānīta know, enam him, yathābhūtam as he truly is, śreyaḥ welfare, hi indeed, atra in this matter, vidhīyatām let it be done.
explanation: He said, "This mighty-armed king, Ila, is the son of Kardama; know him as he truly is, and indeed, let his welfare be ensured in this matter."

shloka_text: तेषां संवदतामेव तमाश्रममुपागमत् । कर्दमस्तु महातेजा द्विजैः सह महात्मभिः ।। 7.90.8 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ saṃvadatāmeva tamāśramamupāgamat | kardamastu mahātejā dvijaiḥ saha mahātmabhiḥ || 7.90.8 ||
translation: तेषां of them, संवदताम् conversing, एव just, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपागमत् approached, कर्दमः Kardama, तु and, महातेजाः highly effulgent, द्विजैः with brahmins, सह together with, महात्मभिः great-souled ones
explanation: Just as they were conversing, the greatly refulgent Kardama approached that hermitage along with other great-souled brahmins.

shloka_text: पुलस्त्यश्च क्रतुश्चैव वषट्कारस्तथैव च । ओङ्कारश्च महातेजास्तमाश्रममुपागमत् ।। 7.90.9 ।।
transliteration: pulastyaśca kratuścaiva vaṣaṭkārastathaiva ca | oṅkāraśca mahātejāstamāśramamupāgamat || 7.90.9 ||
translation: पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, च and, क्रतुः Kratu, च and, एव indeed, वषट्कारः Vaṣaṭkāra, तथा similarly, एव indeed, च and, ओङ्कारः Oṅkāra, च and, महातेजाः highly effulgent, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपागमत् approached
explanation: Pulastya, Kratu, Vaṣaṭkāra, and the greatly effulgent Oṅkāra also similarly approached that hermitage.

shloka_text: ते सर्वे हृष्टमनसः परस्परसमागमे । हितैषिणो बाल्हिपतेः पृथग्वाक्यान्यथाब्रुवन् ।। 7.90.10 ।।
transliteration: te sarve hṛṣṭamanasaḥ parasparasamāgame | hitaiṣiṇo bālhipateḥ pṛthagvākyānyathābruvan || 7.90.10 ||
translation: ते they, सर्वे all, हृष्टमनसः with joyful minds, परस्परसमागमे at their mutual meeting, हितैषिणः well-wishers, बाल्हिपतेः of the king of Bālhika, पृथक् separately, वाक्यानि words, अथ then, अब्रुवन् spoke
explanation: All of them, delighted at their mutual meeting and being well-wishers of the king of Bālhika, then spoke different words.

shloka_text: कर्दमस्त्वब्रवीद्वाक्यं सुतार्थं परमं हितम् । द्विजाः शृणुत मद्वाक्यं यच्छ्रेयः पार्थिवस्य हि ।। 7.90.11 ।।
transliteration: kardamastvabravīdvākyaṃ sutārthaṃ paramaṃ hitam | dvijāḥ śṛṇuta madvākyaṃ yacchreyaḥ pārthivasya hi || 7.90.11 ||
translation: कर्दमः Kardama, तु and, अब्रवीत् spoke, वाक्यम् words, सुतार्थम् for the sake of a son, परमम् supreme, हितम् beneficial, द्विजाः O brahmins, शृणुत listen, मद्वाक्यम् my words, यत् which, श्रेयः welfare, पार्थिवस्य of the king, हि indeed
explanation: Kardama then spoke words that were supremely beneficial for the sake of a son, saying, "O brahmins, listen to my words which are indeed for the welfare of the king."

shloka_text: नान्यं पश्यामि भैषज्यमन्तरा वृषभध्वजम् । नाश्वमेधात्परो यज्ञः प्रियश्चैव महात्मनः । तस्माद्यजामहे सर्वे पार्थिवार्थे दुरासदम् ।। 7.90.12 ।।
transliteration: nānyaṃ paśyāmi bhaiṣajyamantarā vṛṣabhadhvajam | nāśvamedhātparo yajñaḥ priyaścaiva mahātmanaḥ | tasmādyajāmahe sarve pārthivārthe durāsadam || 7.90.12 ||
translation: न not, अन्यम् other, पश्यामि I see, भैषज्यम् remedy, अन्तरा without, वृषभध्वजम् Lord Shiva, न not, अश्वमेधात् than the Ashvamedha sacrifice, परः superior, यज्ञः sacrifice, प्रियः dear, च and, एव indeed, महात्मनः to the great-souled one, तस्मात् therefore, यजामहे let us sacrifice, सर्वे all, पार्थिवार्थे for the sake of the king, दुरासदम् formidable
explanation: I see no other remedy except Lord Shiva, and there is no sacrifice superior to the Ashvamedha, which is indeed dear to the great-souled one; therefore, let us all perform the formidable Ashvamedha sacrifice for the sake of the king.

shloka_text: कर्दमेनैवमुक्तास्तु सर्व एव द्विजर्षभाः । रोचयन्ति स्म तं यज्ञं रुद्रस्याराधनं प्रति ।। 7.90.13 ।।
transliteration: kardamenaivamuktāstu sarva eva dvijarṣabhāḥ | rocayanti sma taṃ yajñaṃ rudrasyārādhanaṃ prati || 7.90.13 ||
translation: कर्दमेनैव by Kardama thus, उक्ताः spoken, तु indeed, सर्वे all, एव indeed, द्विजर्षभाः best among Brahmins, रोचयन्ति स्म approved, तम् that, यज्ञम् sacrifice, रुद्रस्य of Rudra, आराधनम् worship, प्रति for.
explanation: All the eminent Brahmins, thus addressed by Kardama, approved of that sacrifice intended for the worship of Rudra.

shloka_text: संवर्तस्य तु राजर्षेः शिष्यः पुरपुरञ्जयः । मरुत्त इति विख्यातस्तं यज्ञं समुपाहरत् ।। 7.90.14 ।।
transliteration: saṃvartasya tu rājarṣeḥ śiṣyaḥ purapurañjayaḥ | marutta iti vikhyātastaṃ yajñaṃ samupāharat || 7.90.14 ||
translation: संवर्तस्य of Samvarta, तु indeed, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, शिष्यः disciple, पुरपुरञ्जयः conqueror of cities, मरुत्तः Marutta, इति thus, विख्यातः renowned, तम् that, यज्ञम् sacrifice, समुपाहरत् performed.
explanation: The renowned Marutta, a disciple of the royal sage Samvarta and a conqueror of cities, then performed that sacrifice.

shloka_text: ततो यज्ञो महानासीद्बुधाश्रमसमीपतः । रुद्रश्च परमं तोषमाजगाम महायशाः ।। 7.90.15 ।।
transliteration: tato yajño mahānāsīdbudhāśramasamīpataḥ | rudraśca paramaṃ toṣamājagāma mahāyaśāḥ || 7.90.15 ||
translation: ततः then, यज्ञः sacrifice, महान् great, आसीत् was, बुधाश्रमसमीपतः near Budha's hermitage, रुद्रः Rudra, च and, परमम् supreme, तोषम् satisfaction, आजगाम attained, महायशाः highly renowned.
explanation: A great sacrifice then took place near Budha's hermitage, and the highly renowned Rudra attained supreme satisfaction.

shloka_text: अथ यज्ञे समाप्ते तु प्रीतः परमया मुदा । उमापतिर्द्विजान्सर्वानुवाच इलसन्निधौ ।। 7.90.16 ।।
transliteration: atha yajñe samāpte tu prītaḥ paramayā mudā | umāpatirdvijānsarvānuvāca ilasannidhau || 7.90.16 ||
translation: अथ then, यज्ञे समाप्ते when the sacrifice was concluded, उमापतिः the lord of Uma, प्रीतः pleased, परमया मुदा with supreme joy, इलसन्निधौ in Ila's presence, सर्वान् द्विजान् all the brahmins, उवाच addressed.
explanation: Then, when the sacrifice was concluded, the lord of Uma, pleased and filled with supreme joy, addressed all the brahmins there in Ila's presence.

shloka_text: प्रीतो ऽस्मि हयमेधेन भक्त्या च द्विजसत्तमाः । अस्य बाह्लिपतेश्चैव किं करोमि प्रियं शुभम् ।। 7.90.17 ।।
transliteration: prīto 'smi hayamedhena bhaktyā ca dvijasattamāḥ | asya bāhlipateścaiva kiṃ karomi priyaṃ śubham || 7.90.17 ||
translation: प्रीतः pleased, अस्मि I am, हयमेधेन by the horse sacrifice, भक्त्या by devotion, च and, द्विजसत्तमाः O best among Brahmins, अस्य of this, बाह्लिपतेः of the lord of Bahlika, च and, एव indeed, किम् what, करोमि shall I do, प्रियम् pleasing, शुभम् auspicious.
explanation: Rudra declared, "O best among Brahmins, I am pleased by this horse sacrifice and by your devotion; what pleasing and auspicious thing shall I do for this lord of Bahlika?"

shloka_text: तथा वदति देवेशे द्विजास्ते सुसमाहिताः । प्रसादयन्ति देवेशं यथा स्यात्पुरुषस्त्विला ।। 7.90.18 ।।
transliteration: tathā vadati deveśe dvijāste susamāhitāḥ | prasādayanti deveśaṃ yathā syātpuruṣastvilā || 7.90.18 ||
translation: तथा thus, वदति speaking, देवेशे when the lord of gods, द्विजाः Brahmins, ते those, सुसमाहिताः well-composed, प्रसादयन्ति propitiated, देवेशम् the lord of gods, यथा so that, स्यात् may become, पुरुषः a man, तु indeed, इला Ila.
explanation: When the lord of gods spoke thus, those attentive Brahmins propitiated him so that Ila might indeed become a man again.

shloka_text: ततः प्रीतो महादेवः पुरुषत्वं ददौ पुनः । इलायै सुमहातेजा दत्त्वा चान्तरधीयत ।। 7.90.19 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prīto mahādevaḥ puruṣatvaṃ dadau punaḥ | ilāyai sumahātejā dattvā cāntaradhīyata || 7.90.19 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रीतो pleased, महादेवः Mahadeva, पुरुषत्वं manhood, ददौ gave, पुनः again, इलायै to Ila, सुमहातेजा of great splendor, दत्त्वा having given, च and, अन्तरधीयत disappeared.
explanation: Then, the greatly effulgent Mahadeva, being pleased, restored Ila to manhood, and having done so, he disappeared.

shloka_text: निवृत्ते हयमेधे च गतश्चादर्शनं हरः । यथागतं द्विजाः सर्वे ह्यगच्छन्दीर्घदर्शिनः ।। 7.90.20 ।।
transliteration: nivṛtte hayamedhe ca gataścādarśanaṃ haraḥ | yathāgataṃ dvijāḥ sarve hyagacchandīrghadarśinaḥ || 7.90.20 ||
translation: निवृत्ते having concluded, हयमेधे the horse sacrifice, च and, गतश्च went and, अदर्शनं out of sight, हरः Hara, यथागतं as they had come, द्विजाः Brahmins, सर्वे all, हि indeed, अगच्छन् went, दीर्घदर्शिनः far-sighted ones.
explanation: After the horse sacrifice was concluded, Hara disappeared, and all the wise Brahmins returned to their respective places as they had come.

shloka_text: राजा तु बाह्लिमुत्सृज्य मध्यदेशे ह्यनुत्तमम् । निवेशयामास पुरं प्रतिष्ठानं यशस्करम् ।। 7.90.21 ।।
transliteration: rājā tu bāhlimutsṛjya madhyadeśe hyanuttamam | niveśayāmāsa puraṃ pratiṣṭhānaṃ yaśaskaram || 7.90.21 ||
translation: राजा the king, तु but, बाह्लिम् Bahli, उत्सृज्य having abandoned, मध्यदेशे in the central region, हि indeed, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, निवेशयामास established, पुरं a city, प्रतिष्ठानं Pratishthana, यशस्करम् glorious.
explanation: But the king, having left Bahli, established the glorious and unsurpassed city of Pratishthana in the central region.

shloka_text: शशबिन्दुश्च राजर्षिर्बाह्लिं पुरपुरञ्जयः । प्रतिष्ठाने इलो राजा प्रजापतिसुतो बली ।। 7.90.22 ।।
transliteration: śaśabinduśca rājarṣirbāhliṃ purapurañjayaḥ | pratiṣṭhāne ilo rājā prajāpatisuto balī || 7.90.22 ||
translation: शशबिन्दुः Shashabindu, च and, राजर्षिः royal sage, बाह्लिम् Bahli, पुरपुरञ्जयः conqueror of cities, प्रतिष्ठाने in Pratishthana, इलः Ila, राजा king, प्रजापतिसुतः son of Prajapati, बली powerful.
explanation: The royal sage Shashabindu, a conqueror of cities, ruled Bahli, while the powerful King Ila, son of Prajapati, ruled in Pratishthana.

shloka_text: स काले प्राप्तवाँल्लोकमिलो ब्राह्ममनुत्तमम् । ऐलः पुरूरवा राजा प्रतिष्ठानमवाप्तवान् ।। 7.90.23 ।।
transliteration: sa kāle prāptavāँllokamilo brāhmamanuttamam | ailaḥ purūravā rājā pratiṣṭhānamavāptavān || 7.90.23 ||
translation: सः he, काले in time, प्राप्तवान् attained, लोकम् world, इलः Ila, ब्राह्मम् of Brahma, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, ऐलः Aila, पुरूरवा Pururava, राजा king, प्रतिष्ठानम् Pratishthana, अवाप्तवान् obtained.
explanation: In due course, King Ila attained the unsurpassed divine realm of Brahma, and his son, King Pururava Aila, then obtained Pratishthana.

shloka_text: ईदृशो ह्यश्वमेधस्य प्रभावः पुरुषर्षभौ । स्त्रीभूतः पौरुषं लेभे यच्चान्यदपि दुर्लभम् ।। 7.90.24 ।।
transliteration: īdṛśo hyaśvamedhasya prabhāvaḥ puruṣarṣabhau | strībhūtaḥ pauruṣaṃ lebhe yaccānyadapi durlabham || 7.90.24 ||
translation: ईदृशः such, हि indeed, अश्वमेधस्य of the Ashwamedha sacrifice, प्रभावः power, पुरुषर्षभौ O best among men, स्त्रीभूतः having become a woman, पौरुषं manhood, लेभे obtained, यत् च and what, अन्यत् अपि other also, दुर्लभम् difficult to obtain.
explanation: Indeed, such is the power of the Ashwamedha sacrifice, O best among men, that one who had become a woman regained manhood and obtained other things that are difficult to achieve. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे नवतितमः सर्गः ।। 90 ।। Thus ends the ninetieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
